📰 CMU Wi-Fi Vision: Smart Speakers Seeing Without Cameras

Researchers at Carnegie Mellon University developed a breakthrough system that translates ordinary Wi-Fi router signals into precise human pose estimation. This transforms ambient smart devices into vision-capable sensors without utilizing a single optical camera.

📅 19 Oct 2026 | Source: Researchers at Carnegie Mellon University have developed a system that uses Wi-Fi signals to detect human motion, demonstrating the potential for devices like smart speakers to gain 'sight' without cameras.
